feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: US charges three men allegedly linked to RAF Fairford incident
articles.summary: Three men have been accused by US authorities of being Iran-supported operatives who plotted more than a dozen attacks, including an alleged terrorist plot near a UK military base where American aircraft were stationed.

articles.title: Ex-investigator admits depriving war crimes probe of potentially valuable information
articles.summary: A former senior investigating officer for the Royal Military Police has admitted depriving a war crimes investigation of potentially valuable information.

articles.title: Train driver 'heard someone screaming' about knifeman stabbing people
articles.summary: The driver of a London-bound train on which 10 people were stabbed told a court he "heard someone screaming" through a door microphone that a knifeman was attacking people.

articles.title: Seven people taken to hospital after car collides with pedestrians
articles.summary: Seven people have been taken to hospital after a car collided with a "number of pedestrians" in Glasgow, police say.

articles.title: UK court overturns Trinidad and Tobago law criminalising homosexual sex
articles.summary: ‌Trinidad and Tobago's ‌law criminalising consensual sexual ​relations between male same-sex couples has been overturned ‌by a ​UK court.

articles.title: Poundland owner releases £10m to retailer hours before MP grilling
articles.summary: Poundland's owner has released millions of pounds of funding to pay the discount retailer's suppliers - a breakthrough in talks about saving the company and its 10,500 staff.

articles.title: Harry delivers solo speech to EU parliament after Meghan pulls out
articles.summary: Prince Harry has delivered a keynote address to the European parliament on online child safety, a day after his wife, Meghan, pulled out of what should have been a joint speech.
